title: 혀 뒤쪽 붙였다 떼기
instruction: 혀 뒤쪽을 연구개 방향으로 천천히 붙였다가 떼세요.
caption: 혀 뒤쪽을 올려 천천히 붙였다 떼세요.
motion_prompt: Lift the back of the tongue gently toward the soft-palate area, make a controlled contact-and-release motion, then return to the resting tongue position. Show one slow cycle that can be sped up by the app.
face_animation_policy: 중립·목표·복귀의 얼굴 전체 자세를 먼저 설계한다. 운동에 필요한 턱·볼·입꼬리·턱선을 함께 연동하고 선화·명암·질감을 맞춘다. 정지 얼굴 위에 입 도형만 교체하는 방식은 사용하지 않는다. 혀 독립 운동의 턱 안정은 해당 운동 의도를 따른다.
poses: tongue resting low inside the mouth, hard palate and soft palate clearly distinct
POSTERIOR tongue dorsum raised toward and gently contacting the SOFT PALATE behind the hard palate; tongue TIP stays forward and relatively low, no tip-to-front-palate substitute
posterior tongue relaxed and lowered again, no contact, calm comfortable open airway schematic
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Animation keyframe atlas for tongue_05_soft_palate_click. EXACTLY 1 columns and 3 rows of equal rectangular 16:9 tiles, edge-to-edge, NO gaps, NO borders, NO labels. Overall aspect ratio 16:27. Read tiles row-major left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each tile contains ONE complete scene, not multiple views. Create a clean non-graphic clinical educational 2D illustration matching the warm cel-shaded palette of the reference. Neutral pale warm background, large isolated mouth anatomy, no extra therapist portrait or inset. Keep the exact SAME oral geometry, camera and scale across all tiles. Distinguish ivory teeth, pink gingiva and hard/soft palate, single pink muscular tongue. Clear natural contact surfaces, no intersection through teeth or roof. No gore, saliva or surgery. This is an illustrative draft for professional review. Stable SIDE SAGITTAL mouth cutaway facing VIEWER-LEFT: lips/front teeth at left, throat at right; upper/lower jaw, alveolar ridge, hard palate and posterior soft palate visible. Do not show a frontal view. Tile poses: TILE 1: tongue resting low inside the mouth, hard palate and soft palate clearly distinct. TILE 2: POSTERIOR tongue dorsum raised toward and gently contacting the SOFT PALATE behind the hard palate; tongue TIP stays forward and relatively low, no tip-to-front-palate substitute. TILE 3: posterior tongue relaxed and lowered again, no contact, calm comfortable open airway schematic. Crucial: each pose must differ by the REQUESTED movement, not random expression. One tongue only, no extra teeth, no detached lips, no camera cuts, no text, numbers, arrows, captions, logos, watermark or UI.
